metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in the job_execution task_family at the execute stage. It addresses job submission and result retrieval—a capability not present in existing_skills (which cover thread pool execution and Future state inspection, orthogonal domains). Peer candidates cover environment initialization and result collection via Iterator sink, but neither directly addresses StreamExecutionEnvironment.execute()/executeAsync() submission and JobExecutionResult retrieval. The candidate is semantically unique, well-scoped, and supported by DataStream API evidence.
